note: A study of where the per-turn skill selection shows: 1a, a line in the composer before send (the design's recommendation), or 1b, only on the sent message. Neither option is ruled on. Option labels, eyebrows and captions are annotations; the composer chips and the sample prompt are the fictional session.
sample: Triage the open PRs on the webhook branch before you touch the handler.
annotations: Per-turn skill selection in the composer
sets which skills the next turn uses. The daemon can refuse a selection. Recommended:
A quiet line in the composer
The selection is state for the next turn, so it shows where you change it. A refusal arrives before you send, while it can still be fixed.
The composer stays clean. The record is exact, but you learn of a refusal after the turn has started without that skill.
Nothing shows the selection before send.
The refusal is on the record, but only after the turn started.
The line appears only once a skill is selected. Without one, the composer is unchanged.
The refused skill stays on the line, struck through, with the daemon's reason. Send still works; that turn runs without it.

elements.name: Next-turn skill line in the composer (option 1a)
elements.where: above the composer field, only once a skill is selected: Next turn, a chip per selected skill, a refused skill struck through with the daemon's reason, the count of the per-turn limit, Clear or Review <skill>

missing.reason: study option 1a, recommended by the design and not ruled on; /skill keeps the selection in the composer draft (thread.tsx skillSelection) but nothing draws it before send, and no refusal reaches the composer before send

elements.name: Skills on the sent message (option 1b)
elements.where: under the sent user message: Skills this turn with the delivered skills, then a refused skill with its reason and The turn runs without it

partial.reason: study option 1b, not ruled on; PromptDeliveryNote already records delivered and omitted skills under the sent turn in its own words (Sent with, omitted before send), not the drawn Skills this turn and Refused lines
